facts.fact: HPE says Mzansi Mind, a Solcon Capital sovereign enterprise AI platform, runs its Siya language model supporting all official South African languages on HPE servers hosted in Johannesburg.
HPE says Mzansi Mind's inferencing environment uses HPE ProLiant DL380a Gen12 servers with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, hosted at Equinix's Johannesburg colocation data centre.

systems.platform: HPE servers with NVIDIA GPUs at Equinix Johannesburg
